issues.evidence: Caption 'One request. A team of assistants.' sits over the single-agent plan recording ('Building the response 3 of 3 completed'), and VO says 'Assistants plan the work, check it, and hand it off.' CAPTURE_LOG: 06-agent-handoff 'No. One agent plans and works across three files. There is no handoff between two agents.' The only handoff shown is 'Priya's Assistant', which is a scripted room-API simulation, and the real 'Invite my Assistant' join failed.
issues.suggested_action: Change the caption and VO to single-assistant truth, e.g. 'One request. Every file it touches.' Keep any multi-agent beat only inside the Room block with a legible 'demo session, simulated teammate' label, and do not claim agents hand off to each other.

issues.evidence: Caption 'Only a person says yes.' and VO 'Every proposal still waits for a person.' CAPTURE_LOG for collab-demo-take records that at 19.8 s 'Priya's Assistant writes §3: "26 months" becomes "28 months" live on the page', so an agent edit landed with no human approval. The approval mode is 'Default Approvals', which is unconfirmed. The brief says 'No guaranteed autonomous completion'; the claim reads as an unapproved guarantee.
issues.suggested_action: Soften to 'Proposals wait for your review.' and confirm the approval behaviour with the product team, or cut 'Only a person says yes.'
